tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Execute raw SQL against the database (runs as a read-only Postgres user in read-only mode).

tools.name: generate_typescript_types
tools.description: Generate TypeScript types from the database schema.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Get logs for a project by service type (api, postgres, auth, storage, …).

tools.name: list_edge_functions
tools.description: List all Edge Functions in a project.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all Supabase projects for the user (account-scoped).

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables within the specified schemas.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Supabase documentation for up-to-date guidance.
